catalogue.description: Per-check overrides (URL, wait condition, selectors, on or off), keyed by check id. Empty means the bundled catalogue. This is how a broken page reader is fixed without a store update.

cloud_models.description: Cloud models in the order to try them.

cloud_on.description: Turns every cloud step off for all installs. The product still works from the on-device steps library.

two_voice_on.description: The two-voice check on the plan.

freshness_on.description: The steps freshness check (reads the official help page with the URL context tool).

max_cloud_calls.description: Most cloud calls one scan may make.

fresh_days.description: Days after which a steps library entry counts as stale.

plan_templates.description: Firebase AI Logic server prompt templates the cloud plan is asked through, in order. Empty: the direct call only. The direct call is always the last backup.

device_models.description: Android on-device models in order: preview_fast (Gemini Nano 4 Fast), preview (Gemini Nano 4 Full), stable (the Gemini Nano a phone ships with). The first one the phone has is used.

hotline.description: The hotline shown on every screen.
